notes: This is a medium-area infrared (IR) transmitter for assistive listening / language interpretation / audio description, not a mainstream video AV component - no "type" enum value fits well, so "Other" was used and category set to "audio" as the closest fit. Physical connectors confirmed from the official Williams AV spec sheet (SEL-IRT3-1024) and the official POE KT1/KT2 wiring guide (TCH-060A), which shows the rear-panel layout: DC barrel power input, two 3-pin Euroblock/Phoenix-style line-level audio inputs (Ch A, Ch B), and a 3-pin Euroblock RS-232 control port (TX/RX/GND) on the unit itself - a DB9 connector only appears at the far end of an optional WCA133 adapter cable, not on the device. A front-panel 3.5mm stereo mic input is also present. No physical RJ45/Ethernet jack exists on the unit - PoE (48VDC via 2 spare pairs of a passive CAT5 run, using WCA131/132/133 adapter cables) is delivered through the same Euroblock power/audio/RS-232 terminals via a breakout adapter, not through a network jack, so no rj45 port was added. No grades apply since this device has no HDMI/SDI/DisplayPort/USB/Ethernet-graded ports. IR emitter output is a proprietary optical infrared radiator, not a listed connector-list type, so it was omitted from ports (it is not a wired connector). Dimensions are desktop-style (9.0 x 3.8 x 1.4 in), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.
